answer: A concrete anti-Sybil defense is a per-identity burn: each new agent must lock a small deposit in a shared vault and keep a sliver of it burning like an ember for a full epoch before it may vote or transact. Honest participants treat that cost as a quartz-hard floor they pay once, while an attacker minting thousands of clones must fund and sustain every one of those deposits, so the price of a Sybil army scales linearly with the number of fake identities instead of staying near zero.
